items.source: A builder for Neo4jTransactionManager.
items.translation: 用于构建Neo4jTransactionManager的类。

items.source: Configures the database selection provider. Make sure to use the same instance as for a possible Neo4jClient. During runtime, it will be checked if a call is made for the same database when happening in a managed transaction.
items.translation: 配置数据库选择提供者。请确保使用与可能的 Neo4jClient 相同的实例。在运行时，当处于托管事务中时，将检查是否对同一数据库发起了调用。

items.source: Configures a provider for impersonated users. Make sure to use the same instance as for a possible Neo4jClient. During runtime, it will be checked if a call is made for the same user when happening in a managed transaction.
items.translation: 为代理用户配置提供者。请确保使用与可能的Neo4jClient相同的实例。在运行时，当处于托管事务中时，将检查是否针对同一用户发起了调用。
配置数据库选择提供程序。

items.source: Configures a provider for impersonated users.
items.translation: 为模拟用户配置提供程序。
userSelectionProvider - 用于模拟用户的提供者
